pages.text: Smelt your first Steel. Thermal is the Tier 2 tech mod, and Steel is the T2 baseline the Engineering lane runs on.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() The Induction Smelter makes Steel Ingots efficiently. The Series also covers Energy, Dynamics (pipes and ducts) and Cultivation (farming machines).$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$() Ore doubling and tripling start at Tier 2. An Induction Smelter and Pulverizer setup yields 2 to 3 ingots per ore.

$(bold)Material relevance:$() Signalum, Lumium and Enderium are Thermal's Tier 2 to 3 alloys; in this pack Enderium is a T3 material.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$() The Efficient Engineering passive speeds up every Thermal machine. A T2 Artificer with a good Skill investment is well ahead on material production.

$(bold)No book needed.$() JEI lists every Thermal Series machine recipe, augment slot and component.$(br2)$(bold)Next: start doubling ore$() with a Pulverizer and Redstone Furnace pair. $(l:icraft:engineering/t2_infrastructure)T2: Infrastructure$(/l) walks the build order.
